mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 56 degrees under clear skies with a stunning Full Moon visible over Fireman's Park.

Please plan your travels carefully as Hwy M will be closed from October 5 to October 7 for final asphalt and pavement work near the new Aldi. Additionally, phase two of the Aldi road development continues to shift traffic patterns on Hwy M.

There is plenty to do in our community, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's, while the Downtown Farmer's Market and more music events are coming up on September 30.
Regarding local public safety, officers investigated a strange incident on September 5 involving multiple vehicles found with slices of cheese on their windshields as part of a social media trend.
Today is the perfect day to stop by for the Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie flavor of the day, and you can head over when the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
